AdapterRecord.description:
One record from ``SourceAdapter.iter_record_batches``, validated at the worker boundary.

``raw_fields`` holds original values as text. Normalized values are nullable: an unknown
unit stays null with a quality finding, and is never guessed.
AdapterRecord.title: AdapterRecord

AdminEntitlement.description: A source entitlement. Its classification is the source's, set by the server.
AdminEntitlement.title: AdminEntitlement

AdminUserCreateRequest.description:
Provisions an identity in the administrator's own tenant. Issuer plus subject is the key;
an email address is never used as the identity.
AdminUserCreateRequest.title: AdminUserCreateRequest

AdminUserDetail.description: A user in the administrator's tenant with what the server would grant them now.
AdminUserDetail.title: AdminUserDetail

AgentDraftResponse.description: Structured agent output. The server still validates citations before using it.
AgentDraftResponse.title: AgentDraftResponse

AlertDeliveryState.description: Sent, delivered and read are distinct; none of them implies acknowledgment.
AlertDeliveryState.title: AlertDeliveryState

AlertSummary.description: Inbox item. Severity is an operational priority, not a legal status.
AlertSummary.title: AlertSummary

AnalysisRun.description: Immutable: a rerun creates a new ``analysis_run_id``.
AnalysisRun.title: AnalysisRun

CaseCandidate.description: Passed to ``cases.upsert_candidate`` by the relevance pipeline, one per notice version.
CaseCandidate.title: CaseCandidate

CaseDetail.description: Method runs load from ``GET /analyses/{id}`` so values have one canonical source.
CaseDetail.title: CaseDetail

CriterionCheck.description: Separate from the method run. Positive upper-bound margins are potential exceedances only.
CriterionCheck.title: CriterionCheck

DeviceRegistrationRequest.description: The push token is write-only: it never appears in a response.
DeviceRegistrationRequest.title: DeviceRegistrationRequest

DomainEvent.description: Immutable event written to the outbox and consumed by the versioned alert rules.
DomainEvent.title: DomainEvent

DownloadLinkRequest.description: The client must confirm it warned the user about a potentially multi-GB transfer.
DownloadLinkRequest.title: DownloadLinkRequest

DraftCreated.description: A new draft is always unapproved. Only a review event can change that.
DraftCreated.title: DraftCreated

DraftUpdateRequest.description: Text only: an edit cannot change status or citations, so it can never approve.
DraftUpdateRequest.title: DraftUpdateRequest

FrequencyReferenceMatch.description: One Finnish reference interval that a screened range overlaps. A screening signal only.
FrequencyReferenceMatch.title: FrequencyReferenceMatch

FrequencyRelevanceScreen.description: Stage one of TR-REL-004 (frequency). Service, geometry and technical stages stay null.
FrequencyRelevanceScreen.title: FrequencyRelevanceScreen

IficAnalysis.description: One analysed IFIC issue (DECISIONS G27). Priority is for ordering work, not a finding.
IficAnalysis.title: IficAnalysis

IficFinding.description: One screened notice. ``detail`` holds every stage result, calculation and assumption.
IficFinding.title: IficFinding

IngestRequest.description: Refers to an already staged artifact. Arbitrary URLs and paths are not accepted.
IngestRequest.title: IngestRequest

JobRun.description: Progress is bytes, records and stage. There is no percent field to invent.
JobRun.title: JobRun

MethodAssessment.description: What ``RFMethod.assess_applicability`` must return, validated at the worker boundary.
MethodAssessment.title: MethodAssessment

MethodCalculation.description: What ``RFMethod.calculate`` must return, validated at the worker boundary.
MethodCalculation.title: MethodCalculation

MethodRun.description: One row per candidate method per scenario, even when the method did not run (BSD 3.7).
MethodRun.title: MethodRun

OperationsMetrics.description: Tenant-scoped counts for operators (TR-NFR-004/009). No payloads or error details.
OperationsMetrics.title: OperationsMetrics

PublisherAuthStatus.description: Origin trust, deliberately separate from byte integrity and parse status.
PublisherAuthStatus.title: PublisherAuthStatus

PushCategory.description: Generic lock-screen safe categories. Never carries case or source content.
PushCategory.title: PushCategory

PushPayload.description: All an OS notification may carry. Details are fetched only after re-authorization.
PushPayload.title: PushPayload

ReferenceStationRecord.description: Normalized national reference row. Unknown values are null, never zero or a guessed unit.
ReferenceStationRecord.title: ReferenceStationRecord

RelevanceGates.description: Separate gates. A frequency match alone never implies interference.
RelevanceGates.title: RelevanceGates

ReviewEvent.description: Append-only. The actor comes from the validated identity, never the request.
ReviewEvent.title: ReviewEvent

SourceConnector.description: Connector status for clients. Endpoint and credential references stay server-side.
SourceConnector.title: SourceConnector

SourcePreview.description: A bounded read-only slice of the original. It never carries the whole archive.
SourcePreview.title: SourcePreview

SourceRecordDetail.description: Original values beside their interpretation, for the indexed-record view.
SourceRecordDetail.title: SourceRecordDetail

UploadCompleteRequest.description: The server hashes the final assembled bytes; the client digest is only compared to it.
UploadCompleteRequest.title: UploadCompleteRequest

UploadCreateRequest.description: ``content_sha256`` is a digest supplied with a manifest. It is never publisher proof.
UploadCreateRequest.title: UploadCreateRequest

get.description: Frequency stage of the Finland relevance filter. A match is a screening signal only.
Re-checks identity and entitlement on every call. The original bytes, unchanged.

put.description: Local object store only. Streams to disk, so a part never sits in process memory.
